items.title: Orama-Interactive/Pixelorama
items.description: Unleash your creativity with Pixelorama, a powerful and accessible open-source pixel art multitool. Whether you want to create sprites, tiles, animations, or just express yourself in the language of pixel art, this software will realize your pixel-perfect dreams with a vast toolbox of features. Available on Windows, Linux, macOS and the Web!
items.cn_summary: 开源像素艺术全能工具，支持精灵、动画与瓦片创作

items.title: InterWebCoder: Learning Interactive Webpage Generation from Executable Tests via Reinforcement Learning
items.description: Interactive webpages underpin modern applications, but reproducing both their visual appearance and multi-step behavior remains challenging for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). Scalable training data must capture user actions, state transitions, and expected outcomes, while real-world webpage code is often entangled with irrelevant scripts and external dependencies.
